title-screen.alt: The title screen on a near-black background with faint blue stars. "Pattern Break" in large cyan pixel letters with a magenta shadow, over a row of small LED segments shading from green to red. Below it, in small pixel type: the song title "pb fixture 01", the line "Generated by this repository. MIT license.", the word "Difficulty" over "1 Easy", "[2 Normal]" in amber and "3 Hard", the line "Arrows or WASD to move. Esc pauses.", and "Press any key" in cyan.
title-screen.caption: The title screen, with the bundled test song and the difficulty choice. Not used in the README.

gameplay.alt: A frame of play in a tunnel of LED meter columns. Columns of small square segments hang from the top edge and rise from the bottom edge, lit bright green at the edges and yellow to orange further in, with unlit segments in dim brown and dark red and a white peak dot on many columns. Near the left, a few columns have almost nothing lit. A small cyan ship with a magenta and amber engine flame flies left of centre in the dark open band through the middle, with faint blue stars behind.
gameplay.caption: Pattern Break at 21.5 seconds into the test song on normal, with the ship flown by the autopilot.

gameplay-clip.alt: Four seconds of play. The ceiling and floor, columns of square LED segments lit green, yellow and orange with dim unlit segments and white peak dots, scroll from right to left, one column per row of the song, their heights changing with the music. A small cyan ship with a flickering engine flame steers up and down a little in the dark band through the middle, and faint blue stars drift more slowly behind.
gameplay-clip.caption: Four seconds of the test song on normal, flown by the autopilot through the sim.
